title: Made a mech fighting game with Fable 5.2
author: Individual_Canary807
selftext:
1v1 mech arena fighter that runs in the browser. The game design and the mech assets were made with Maneki, and the code was done with Fable 5.2

Play it here: [frostbreak.maneki.gg](https://frostbreak.maneki.gg/)

Would love feedback on how the fights feel!

comments.author: Comet7777
comments.body: Animations are very janky still (especially when there are collisions), but there’s a good base to grow. Not sure I’d call this a full game, but again, a good base to build off of.

comments.author: Guilty_Sherbert_3921
comments.body: Hey just wanted to ask, did you need to know any coding knowledge for making this game?

replies.author: Individual_Canary807
replies.body: no, i didn't code anything myself. just prompting, playing, then prompting again

replies.author: Guilty_Sherbert_3921
replies.body:
That's great

So you promoted directly inside Claude and it build the game for you or you did this inside apps like base 44 or lovable?

replies.author: Individual_Canary807
replies.body: i used [Maneki.gg](http://Maneki.gg), it's essentially Claude Code for games. claude code will get you pretty far but it doesnt have any workflows for making assets or game design, etc.

replies.author: Guilty_Sherbert_3921
replies.body:
So it's basically made for pixelated games. How long did it take you to make this masterpiece?

One more thing I wanted to ask can Claude code make fully working ios apps like scroll the Bible, finch, waterllama etc

replies.author: Individual_Canary807
replies.body:
took me 2-3hrs and $11 in assets.  
yeah it can, it just depends how well you prompt it i think

replies.author: Guilty_Sherbert_3921
replies.body: Work gets a lot effective these days with AI. Brother Thanks for clarifying my doubts ☺️
